products.name: Calibration Due Readiness
products.product: A focused calibration asset due and access tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent calibration laboratories and mobile metrology service teams
products.problem: Asset identity, location, due date, service scope, standards, access, downtime window, pickup, and customer contact are reconciled just before service.
products.valueProposition: Turns calibration asset due and access tracking into a visible operating queue so every due asset has verified identity, location, scope, access, timing, and service disposition.
products.topic: calibration asset due and access tracking
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets calibration asset due and access tracking software, calibration asset due and access tracking tracker, calibration asset due and access tracking template, and calibration asset due and access tracking checklist searches.

products.name: As-Found Exception Desk
products.product: A focused calibration as-found exception tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent calibration laboratories and mobile metrology service teams
products.problem: Out-of-tolerance or damaged conditions require technical review, customer notice, impact handling, adjustment authority, and follow-up that extend beyond the certificate workflow.
products.valueProposition: Turns calibration as-found exception tracking into a visible operating queue so every material as-found exception has a controlled review, customer decision, disposition, and traceable follow-up.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size

products.seoAngle: Targets calibration as-found exception tracking software, calibration as-found exception tracking tracker, calibration as-found exception tracking template, and calibration as-found exception tracking checklist searches.
